query: These tickets need enrichment: CCAL-1971, CCAL-1972, CCAL-1974, CCAL-1976, and CCAL-1977. The source link is in a comment on each ticket, the work is in marketing-pages, and they are all /resources/toolkit items.
expected_behavior: Fetches each Jira ticket and its comments with acli before drafting descriptions
Extracts source URLs from both standard comment links and Jira smart-card inlineCard attrs
Infers toolkit category from the ticket summary prefix, mapping Checklist to checklist, SOP to sop, and Template to template
Fetches accessible Google Doc text exports to capture meta title, meta description, slug, and source title when available

Drafts implementation-ready Jira descriptions with source link, marketing-pages destination file, public route, toolkit category, front matter guidance, PDF and ImageKit requirements, and acceptance criteria
Converts markdown descriptions through tools/md-to-adf before editing Jira so markdown does not render literally
Reports any corrected or skipped ticket keys and verifies the updated descriptions after writing
